notes.title: Patch 11117.01 & Mac version released!
notes.content:
Attention boneless cop simulator enthusiasts! Do you have a Mac? Has your desire to dangle gone unfulfilled? Despair no more Deputy Dangle is now available on Mac!  In addition to the new platform there have been many enhancements and bug fixes to both Mac and Windows versions outlined below.

Patch Notes:

Mac version released.
Optimized assets in the moon lab.
Tweaked bounding colliders in Dangleton.
Fixed backwards wall in the Office Mission.
Removed plungerable properties from pillars in sewer that allowed player to get out of playable area.
Fixed framerate drops during loading areas in the sewer.
Added missing cat bounding volume in cat park.
Simplified physics of some small objects in Dangleton.
Fixed hole in tire models.
Fixed issues with resolution options and aspect ratio
Made changes to reduce camera clipping when player is climbing on the ceiling.
Made changes to prevent camera from going into the ground during the tower climb mission.
Vomit zones on tower climb mission now are not climbable rather than forcing the player to slide downward.
Fixed bug causing vehicles in traffic mission not to update movement visually.
Removed Find-O-Meter during "Question Citizens" sub mission.
Adjusted colliders between semi trucks in traffic mission to prevent player from getting stuck between them.
Fixed bug causing boat camera to not adjust properly when clipping through objects.
Fixed caustics not animating in office mission fish tank.
Changed truck crash cutscene in intro mission to look better and be more clear on what is happening.
Dangle now catches on fire when going through fire particles on tower climb mission.
Removed ability to activate plunger gun during cat pong fight.
Fixed bug allowing play time gui to show on the main menu.

notes.title: Patch 093016.01 Released
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

 Fixed vine material in Sewer Mission, it is now two sided
 Fixed force trigger in pipe loop in Sewer Mission, it now properly applies force to player
 Fixed bug that allowed Chongo to slowly drift away during the into cutscene
 Fixed bug that caused button icons on Dangle to not change when switching to controller type of "None"
 Fixed bug that would cause the button icons on Dangle to be missing when returning to Dangleton from a mission
 Fixed bug that caused characters to occasionally get stuck on the stairs when entering the police station
 Fixed bug that caused the camera shake during the pong fight to move much further than intended and go through walls.
 Fixed dumpsters in Dangleton, the lids should no longer be stuck open and the dumpster and trashcans in Dangleton are simplified for physics
 Changed up and down buttons from Shift(up) and Ctrl(down) to Space(up) and Shift(down) for keyboard controls
 Fixed bug that allowed steam controller d-pad to occasionally not work on the main menu when returning from the story
 Swapped out characters in the shark fishing mission for someone that behaves better with physics
 Put in a 5 second minimum transition time for switching to fixed angle mode on the tower mission so that camera doesnt bounce between modes to quickly.

notes.title: Patch 092216.02 Released
notes.content:
This patch fixes many bugs, fixes areas where players get stuck, and adjusts gameplay based on player feedback.

Patch Notes:

Made punching bags highlight while doing baton tutorial
Stopped Sal from continuing talk animation when transitioning to Traffic Mission
Fixed bug that caused playtime to show if you exit to the main menu
Expanded trigger on tower climb roof so that it can be activated from all sides
Lowered base sensitivity for camera analog speed
Fixed bug that caused Find-O-Meter not to show on first mission after intro
Added Senpai eyes to sharks in Spider-Dangle trial
Added Find-O-Meter for Investigate Tower Explosion too help player find detonator.
Removed confusing dialogue about plunger gun when in Office Mission
Added fade to LOD's and adjusted them for different quality levels to improve performance
Fixed bug allowing you to plunger to ceiling behind the laser wall in the Office Mission
Adjusted the dialogue and quest text in the Skydive mission for clarity
Reduced the number of people to save in the Skydive mission
Increased size of triggers for engines in airplane mission
Made the wings plungerable in the airplane mission
Made performance improvements for characters in Dangleton
Reworked Traffic Mission to make it more varied and shorter.
Reduced fallback speed for Jalopy
Properly cleared follow Chongo quest when returning from the office mission
Adjusted Find-O-Meter when entering and exiting Office Lobby to point at correct target
Added Find-O-Meter for vent behind office lobby
Increased pulse frequency of highlight shaders
Fixed collision missing on Robin for Gitz escape cutscene
Added more camera adjustment triggers to sewer mission
Fixed Find-O-Meter pointing to Chongo instead of sewer after Gtiz escape cutscene
Fixed camera bug allowing in to go though walls in rare circumstances
Tweaked sewer grate in croc fight 1 to be easier to climb
Fixed misplaced collider in Moon Jump
Fixed Trials menu showing in story mode after playing a trial
Reworked first boss encounter in Sewer Mission to be more clear for the player
Fixed a bug where you would be unable to short out Gbot if you attempted to do so preemptively
Fixed a bug where the Gbots flame boosters wouldn't turn off
Added new messages to make your quest objectives in the Gbot fight more coherent
